Name: Truffle Dogs
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

It adds two types of dogs trained to dig white truffles that live in the barn and that you can buy at Marnie's shop, there is a black one and a white one and you make the choice like for the cows and it also adds the white truffle and the white truffle oil that you can produce by putting the white truffle in the Oil Maker, the dogs accept the biscuits to increase production.
It is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23228]Better Truffles[/url], if you have it installed the bubble will appear which makes it much easier to find it on the ground (as you can see in the pictures), so I recommend it.
White truffles and white truffle oil are gifts loved by all citizens.
Configurable in Generic Mod Config Menu.

Languages: English and Italian, translatable into other languages, feel free to translate via i18n and post your translation linking to this mod.
Instructions for those who want to translate:
When you translate an i18n file you must post only the file you translated, zipper it with a zipper program and post it here on Nexus linking my mod as a dependency.

Installation:
Extract and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

Enjoy! <3
